name: Sam Altman
flavorText: Fired on a Friday, rehired by Tuesday.
dailyBlurb: The industry's chief fundraiser and lightning rod — chips, energy, and AGI timelines all route through his calendar.
quips: Raised more money this quarter than most countries print.
Every launch is 'subtle' until the servers melt.
Has a blog post for every civilizational milestone.
The board tried. The board apologized.

name: Ilya Sutskever
tagline: Deep learning pioneer, co-founder of SSI
flavorText: Saw something. Still hasn't said what.
dailyBlurb: Runs the most secretive lab in AI with the largest per-employee war chest ever assembled. Nobody knows what's inside.
quips: Saw something. Won't say what.
Speaks in koans, trains in clusters.
His safety plan is a secret. His conviction is not.

name: Andrej Karpathy
tagline: Teacher of a generation of AI builders
flavorText: Teaches a generation to build GPTs, one YouTube video at a time.
dailyBlurb: The field's favorite teacher. One video from him moves more people into AI than a semester of courses.
quips: Will explain backprop to you whether you asked or not.

name: Demis Hassabis
flavorText: Chess prodigy, game dev, Nobel laureate. Pick a lane? Never.
dailyBlurb: A Nobel Prize later, still treats AGI like a chess endgame — patient, positional, inevitable.
quips: Solved protein folding between chess games.

His lab names everything Alpha. Nobody stops them.

name: Jensen Huang
tagline: NVIDIA founder-CEO, the man selling the shovels
flavorText: Wanted to make video games prettier. Accidentally rescheduled the future.
quips: The jacket is load-bearing.
Signs laptops like guitars now.
'The more you buy, the more you save.' A poet.
Keynotes run longer than some training runs.
Turned graphics cards into the world's most wanted commodity.

name: Geoffrey Hinton
tagline: Godfather of deep learning, Nobel laureate
flavorText: Spent 40 years being right too early. Now spends them being worried on time.
dailyBlurb: The godfather who quit to warn about his own life's work. When Hinton speaks about risk, hearing rooms fill.
quips: Spent 40 years being right too early.
Invented the thing, then rang the alarm about the thing.
Nobel in Physics for making physics nervous.

Retired from Google, not from being cited.

name: OpenAI
tagline: Frontier lab behind GPT and ChatGPT
flavorText: Started as a nonprofit. The rest is a governance case study.
dailyBlurb: Every product cycle still orbits them: each launch resets the industry's roadmap and X's timeline in the same hour.
